risk_note: Admin console /unions PIDs tab (apps/admin pages/unions, texts/unions.ts adding keys only; no money logic; codex-run classed it RV2, so the review ran on the money track). Contract CT-24h (adminListUnionPids, adminCreateUnionPid, adminUpdateUnionPid, adminActivateUnionPid, adminRetireUnionPid; planned, backend B1-22 not done, developed against the contract with a fake server). List read in full with in-page filters; entries by status (pending: change, activate; active: retire; retired: none; never delete); registration with site_id only and required for taobao; change sends only changed fields plus expected_row_version and nothing when unchanged; activation multipart with the 花卷云 ignore time (not later than now) and a PNG / JPEG screenshot of at most 5 MB checked before sending; 30155 shown only after the server answers it, then the list is read again; retire with optional reason; a fresh step-up on every write; 20902 refresh; without union.pid the tab shows no permission and sends no union-pids request. Known contract gap reported: the account list needs union.account_auth. No finalized design spec; boards only as layout reference. Rule tests written by an independent Claude (Codex out of quota until 2026-10-30; ledger tester claude-independent, approvals id 36); Claude spec-test review r1 pass; red on the test machine (red/1: 41 red, 0 problems). Implementation by Opus 5.5; test machine verify-fast/1 and browser/1 green. Adversarial review by a fresh independent Claude (tools/agent/claude-run.sh, money track). Written by hand.
